datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Afghanistan on a monthly basis throughout 2017. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) representing food insecurity scenarios for February, June, and October 2017, with each record containing classification scale, collection date, scenario type, and affected population units.
